assets.caption: EXHIBIT 13-15 — Manning Formula. Log-log nomograph titled "FLOW FOR CIRCULAR PIPE FLOWING FULL — BASED ON MANNING FORMULA (n = 0.013)." X-axis: SLOPE OF PIPE (FT PER 100 FT); Y-axis: FLOW (CUBIC FT PER SECOND). Diagonal families represent pipe diameters (inches) and velocity (ft/sec). Includes handwritten worked-example annotations at 2.36 c.f.s: "12'/100' - 12" LINE - 3 ft/sec", "2.1'/100' - 8" LINE - 4 ft/sec", and "1.0'/100' - 10" LINE - 4 ft/sec".
